note: Invented: the plan for a repair-cafe season, four stacked sections. The third is taller than the screen.

sections.title: Fix it together, first Saturday of the month
text: People bring a broken lamp, a flat bike, a coat with a split seam. Someone who knows how sits with them and shows how to fix it.
Nothing is mended for them while they watch the clock. That is the whole idea, and it is why the evening works.

sections.title: Six repairers and a desk
text: Two for bikes, two for lamps and small electrics, one for sewing and one on the door.
Each repairer brings their own tools. The co-op supplies the benches, the light and the tea.

sections.title: The long list, bench by bench
text: Everything below has an owner by the end of the month. This section is taller than the screen on purpose: it sticks when its bottom meets the bottom of the screen, so all of it can be read before the next one covers it.

list.name: Floor tape
list.text: Marks where visitors wait so the benches stay clear.

list.name: Parts bins
list.text: Sorted by size: screws, washers, fuses, bulbs, plugs.

list.name: Lamp tester
list.text: One mains tester at the electrical bench, checked every night.

list.name: Bike stand
list.text: Two stands, one for kids' bikes.

list.name: Tea urn
list.text: Borrowed from the church hall; return it washed.

list.name: Repair log
list.text: One sheet per item: what, who, fixed or not.

list.name: Sign-in desk
list.text: A table by the door with a pen on a string.

list.name: First-aid kit
list.text: Checked before each night, restocked from the petty cash.

list.name: Spare fuses
list.text: 3 A, 5 A and 13 A, in a labelled tin.

list.name: Soldering mat
list.text: Heat-proof, kept on the electrical bench only.

list.name: Needle tin
list.text: Sewing needles counted in and out.

list.name: Glue shelf
list.text: Contact glue stays on the top shelf, away from the tea.

list.name: Extension leads
list.text: Six, tagged with the date they were last tested.

list.name: Cable ties
list.text: A jar of black and a jar of white.

list.name: Torches
list.text: Two, for looking inside things.

list.name: Waste box
list.text: Beyond repair goes to the recycling run on Sunday.

list.name: Raffle jar
list.text: Coins for the parts fund; empty it on the way out.

list.name: Coat rack
list.text: Visitors' coats go here, not on the benches.

list.name: Magnifier lamp
list.text: Shared between sewing and electrics.

list.name: Whiteboard
list.text: Tonight's repairers and what they can fix.

list.name: Photo release
list.text: Ask before photographing anyone's repair.

list.name: Quiet corner
list.text: For people waiting on a long repair.

list.name: Door counter
list.text: A click counter for the evening's visitors.

list.name: Lost property
list.text: A box. Anything left is kept for a month.

sections.title: Doors at six, last repair at nine
text: Visitors sign in, wait for a free bench and leave with their item mended or with a plain answer about why it cannot be.
At nine the benches are wiped, the log is counted and the tea urn goes back to the church hall.
